name: auto-resume
description: When a turn dies on a rate limit (or an overloaded API), counts down to the reset and sends "continue" for you.

text.title: Resume prompt
text.description: What is sent when the wait is over.

graceSeconds.title: Grace after reset (s)
graceSeconds.description: Extra seconds to wait past the limit's reset time (0-900).

retryOverloaded.title: Retry overloaded/server errors
retryOverloaded.description: Also resume after an overloaded or server error, backing off from one minute.

maxRetries.title: Most retries in a row
maxRetries.description: Give up after this many resumes without a successful answer (1-20).
